key.name: remote-command
key.description: Command prefix used to run the status query on another host, e.g. "ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_monitor server". The query is appended as a single argument and the result is run by the local shell. Empty means the arrays of this machine are monitored.

key.name: poll-interval
key.description: Seconds between status queries while all arrays are idle.

key.name: active-poll-interval
key.description: Seconds between status queries while an array is syncing, checking, or otherwise busy.

key.name: command-timeout
key.description: Seconds after which a status query that has not finished is killed.
